chapters.label: Live: the keeper goes
chapters.text: Futsal World Cup, 2021: Kazakhstan against Thailand. Here’s how keeper Higuita plays. He takes the ball, dribbles out of his area, and keeps going past halfway!

chapters.label: Live: five against four
chapters.text: Now Kazakhstan have an extra attacker: five against four. He shoots... goal! Higuita scored that day.

chapters.label: Replay: someone is free
chapters.text: Watch again. Defenders must choose: mark Higuita, or his teammate. Five against four means someone is always free.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: A brave keeper can dribble out and become an extra attacker. But look first, go only when it’s safe, and sprint back if you lose it.
